message:
feat(update): real effects, with the dangerous half kept out of reach

GNLinkHost, GNLinkStream and GNLinkInputService were running on this machine
while these tests executed. So the isolation here is not a convention the test
agrees to honour -- it is arranged so the test cannot break it.

Finding a product process by image name lives in update_process_targets.cpp,
and that file is not linked into the test binary. The symbols are absent, so
nothing there can call them; searching the test executable for GNLinkHost,
GNLinkStream, GNLinkViewer or GNLinkClient finds zero occurrences, while the
same search of the library finds them. It builds as its own static library so
it cannot rot unused, and links into nothing yet.

UpdateEffectsConfig has no defaults. Not "defaults that tests override" --
none at all, so an unset install directory fails validate() rather than
quietly becoming Program Files, and AcquireLock refuses before anything
starts. Staging inside the install directory is rejected outright.

The swap is two phases: every existing file is moved to a .gnlink-old sibling
first, then the new ones go in, and any failure puts back exactly what was
moved. Backups survive until registration succeeds, because deleting them
earlier trades a recoverable failure for one that isn't. The test locks the
second of two payloads and checks the first is still the old bytes -- which is
ledger I01, where the installer overwrites files one at a time and leaves a
mixture.

Stopping is by exact PID: request, then wait on that process. No name sweep,
no /T, and no TerminateProcess anywhere. A process that ignores the request
keeps running and the update is abandoned before the disk is touched -- there
is a test that leaves a stubborn dummy alive and asserts exactly that.

What this does not show: no real product process was stopped, no real
%ProgramFiles%\GNLink was replaced, and nothing was downloaded over a network.
enumerate_product_processes has been compiled and never run. That verification
belongs to a later field test, per the approved plan.

qwinsta: console active, rdp-tcp listening. 64 checks here; 139, 41 and 57 in
the earlier suites still pass, and the three live PIDs were unchanged before
and after.
